service_type: unit rates apply to RydeTAXI (metered); RydeX is a fixed quote computed from the optimal route with the same units; cancellation / platform fees apply to both. NOTE: rate_per_km / rate_per_min are demo assumptions, NOT the LTA taxi meter units (26c per 400 m = ~$0.65/km; 26c per 45 s only while the taxi is below ~22 km/h) - see lta_taxi_reference
surge_note: surge is NOT modelled in the synthetic data: every case file carries surge_multiplier 1.0, whatever the hour; the peak windows below document the shape of a real surge table and are not applied by data/synth/fare.py
formula: total = (base_fare + distance_km*rate_per_km + time_min*rate_per_min + waiting_min*waiting_rate_per_min) * surge_multiplier + platform_fee - discount ; waiting_min = minutes stationary mid-trip (consecutive 5 s samples < stationary_threshold_m apart, excluding pickup/dropoff); time_min = trip minutes MINUS waiting_min, so a stationary minute is billed once (as waiting) and never also as trip time; platform_fee tier is chosen on the surged subtotal

sources.base_fare: assumed - Ryde does not publish a flag-down; value chosen so a 7.5 km / 18 min Orchard->Marina Bay trip lands in the S$18-22 band quoted by 2024-2026 price comparisons
sources.rate_per_km: assumed - Ryde does not publish unit fares (help article 'How are the trip fares calculated?' only says fares depend on distance, service type and surge); S$1.41/km is the narrative value used across the demo
sources.rate_per_min: assumed - same as above; S$0.26/min mirrors the LTA 26-cent time unit
sources.waiting_rate_per_min: assumed - spec 1.4 bills mid-trip stops per minute; Ryde's real product only has a flat pickup waiting fee (see pickup_waiting_fee_flat)
sources.platform_fee_tiers: policy/sources.md A6 / https://help.rydesharing.com/hc/en-us/articles/22836370596377-Platform-Fee (effective 17 Feb 2026: $1.25 incl. GST for fares <= $18, $1.47 incl. GST above $18)
sources.cancellation_fee: policy/sources.md A1 = https://help.rydesharing.com/hc/en-us/articles/23534478435353-Cancellation-and-Waiting-Fee (rider is charged $6.61 if cancelling > 3 min after matching, or if driver pressed 'I'm Here', waited > 3 min and cancelled as NO SHOW)
sources.cancellation_grace_min: same two Ryde articles: 'All cancellations made within 3 minutes of matching are not chargeable'
sources.pickup_waiting_fee_flat: https://help.rydesharing.com/hc/en-us/articles/23534478435353-Cancellation-and-Waiting-Fee (rider may be charged $5 if driver waited > 3 min at pickup and completed the trip; driver receives $4.50). Not used by fare.py, kept for the policy layer
sources.surge: assumed - Ryde applies dynamic surge but publishes no table; peak windows and 25%/50% typical multipliers mirror LTA taxi peak / late-night surcharge periods
sources.lta_taxi_reference: https://www.lta.gov.sg/content/ltagov/en/getting_around/point_to_point_transport_and_cross_border_services/taxi_fares_payment_methods.html (standard taxi: flag-down $4.40-5.20, 26c per 400 m for 1-10 km, 26c per 350 m above 10 km, 26c per 45 s waiting, peak +25%, midnight-5.59am +50%, city area $3 5pm-midnight, booking fee $2.30). Metered taxi units, NOT applied to PHV fares here.
